Do not include secrets, private data, raw restricted data, or personally identifying information in this public issue.

For sensitive reports, contact the project lead or security maintainer privately.

## Public Summary

Describe the concern at a high level.

## Impact Area

- [ ] Credential or API key
- [ ] Raw/restricted data
- [ ] PII or consent records
- [ ] License/redistribution
- [ ] Vulnerability
- [ ] Public misrepresentation
- [ ] Other

## Suggested Immediate Action

Describe any containment step that does not reveal sensitive details.
